Idea:
The primary motivation for this architectural evolution is to strictly enforce the

callouts.1: Explicit spike encoders: standalone neurons spike the normed input of both sub-layers, the o-norm output and fc1's output (replacing GELU), so every weight sees binary spikes — which the SpikingLinear neurons then spike again.
callouts.2: Conv spike taps: a neuron fires on each ShortConv input, but the conv keeps using the analog signal; the taps only add to the collected spike count.
callouts.3: Spiking decay feedback: the state-norm feedback net becomes SpikingLinear(1→8) → tanh → LIF → SpikingLinear(8→1), so the closed-loop decay control is driven by spikes (its spikes are not collected).
